summary: Governor Mike O'Callaghan is referenced only indirectly in the document, through the Nevada Outdoor Recreation Association's testimony objecting to remarks he made in the Nevada press on July 3 and 4. The NORA characterized his comments as 'naive' and 'irrelevant,' suggesting he had abandoned the environmental concern he showed early in his governorship and was instead serving 'predatory vested interests.' No direct statement from Governor O'Callaghan himself appears in the document.
summary_quote: Specifically, we object-most strenuously—to the naive, irrelevant remarks attributed to Governor Mike O'Callaghan in the Nevada press last July 3 and 4.
